sources.title: Tiffin Girls' School Year 9 Mathematics Curriculum Outline 2026–2027
sources.verified: All four pages read and visual checked; autumn core topics page1; percentages spring page2; similarity and algebraic fractions page3; inequalities and bounds page4.

method: Source-ID screen of previously reviewed 116 questions, selecting latest repair overlay for six. School public year plan is evidence of scheduled core topics, not Set 1 exact lesson completion. Later/unlisted flags conservative; prior teaching may cover some. Grade-demand judgement based on previously recorded mathematics and six revised stems, qualitative not examiner calibration; Ofqual Grade 8 descriptor is for overall attainment, not question certification. Grade 7–9 is not asserted for any individual item.
limits: Not a fresh independent review of six rewritten questions or all distractors. No grade certification, no runtime changes, no Vercel. Before use verify exact prerequisites, calibrate against released exam items, independently review latest revisions and mastery classifications.
